shape.credit: ESA/Rosetta/OSIRIS, LAM/PSI; NASA PDS / ESA PSA; NAIF OBJ conversion
shape.processing: Unmodified scientific mesh, normals calculated at runtime. Global topography is reduced to about 24,000 facets; no photographed surface texture is claimed.
shape.license: Scientific archive data; original archive credit and citation retained.

philae.status: Final location from SONC-FD, distributed by ESA SPICE Service 2017-09-06. The kernel does not supply a numerical uncertainty.
philae.sourceRole: Operational final position; no source accuracy inferred from decimal places.
philae.angularConvention: Planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude, calculated from the source Cartesian coordinates.

rosetta.status: Fixed location from the last state of RORB_DV_257_02_______00344.BSP, ESA SPICE Service 2017-03-29. No post-impact image or surveyed wreck attitude exists.
rosetta.sourceRole: Reconstructed impact location, not confirmation of the present shape or attitude of the wreck.
rosetta.angularConvention: Planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude, calculated from the source Cartesian coordinates.

orientationPolicy: The comet is shown in a fixed body-frame reference pose. Its heliocentric position is date-dependent. Its post-mission spin phase and the current attitudes of the hardware are not claimed to be known.
displayPolicy: Hardware schematics and markers are enlarged. Exact source landing coordinates are retained; the reduced global mesh does not resolve the local landing terrain.

images.context: Actual OSIRIS discovery image of Philae, acquired 2 September 2016.
Actual OSIRIS images of Rosetta's descent site; the wreck itself has never been imaged after impact.
